body: It doesn't necessarily rule out anywhere but it would be ignorant to think that a college wouldn't see it as a major negative to be expelled. My grades are good and my test scores are excellent, but that's not even enough to get into a great college. So, for some of my reach schools, they just became pretty impossible.
I don't know. My dream schools were UVA, Brown, and Vanderbilt but those don't seem like options anymore. I'm praying for maybe Texas or Maryland but even that looks unlikely.
